cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The savings discrepancy is being reconciled. Keep our anniversary reservation, please; don't mix a banking item into the dinner arrangements.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The balance will be restored Friday. Let's work from the settlement date. Last time her name came up, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One person handles the query, please. Leave it with me and keep our table for two; I don't want Friday's money arriving to separate lives.

reason: Use accounting and query-control precision to block discovery while explicitly tying concealment to fear of relational rupture.
